baslik: A Ship Full of Fertilizer Exploded in a Harbor

sahneler.metin: A cargo ship exploded in a Texas harbor.
The blast flattened the waterfront and killed hundreds.
Its cargo was ammonium nitrate fertilizer.
A fire had started deep in the hold.
The crew closed the hatches and pumped in steam to smother it.
That trapped heat, and the fertilizer detonated.
The next day, a second ship exploded too.
Rules for storing and shipping ammonium nitrate were tightened.
